response:
In \ref{fig:LCS}, the dataset generation process is as follows: 
(1) Split the document into sentences. 
(2) Enumerate all unused sentence pairs and generate their normalized copies. 
(3) Calculate the LCS from normalized copies using SuffixAutomaton \url{https://github.com/laohur/SuffixAutomaton}, and pairs with a sufficiently long LCS are considered similar. 
(4) Randomly sample similar pairs into the dataset. 
(5) If a sentence exceeds the maximum length, it will be randomly cropped during the data loading process \cite{izacard2022unsupervised}.
